plain: A regular or repeated change from one thing to another

webster.text: Regular change or succession of one thing to another; as the vicissitudes of day and night, and of winter and summer; the vicissitudes of the seasons.

more.text: Change; revolution; as in human affairs.

example.quote: The intervals of foreign war were filled up by domestic vicissitudes convulsions, and carnage.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 18 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 7, 1787
